findings.quoted_finding: A parte de atingibilidade de AM-L2 é falsa para seletores dependentes da proposta.
defect_evidence: The old AM-L2 sentence changes the proposal after computing prices and still states that the pointwise prices are attainable.
findings.reasoning: For a proposal-dependent selector, changing x can change the selected incidence and therefore the prices. A pointwise ceiling does not supply a fixed point.
findings.disposition: Separate the pointwise upper bound from an attainability statement and require self-consistency for the latter.

findings.quoted_finding: AMX-009 é verdadeiro se ‘plano’ significa globalmente constante em propostas e vetores; é falso sob a leitura apenas ‘constante nos vetores, dada a proposta’.
defect_evidence: The old heading and proof do not state that the flat selector is invariant across proposals.
findings.reasoning: Proposal dependence is enough to invalidate the alleged exact family, while global constancy supports the construction.
findings.disposition: Define AMX-009 only for the globally constant continuation subfamily and preserve the general selector model outside the claim.

findings.quoted_finding: ‘Mesmo membro’ em posteriores diferentes deve ser escrito como a mesma família de incidência F, produzindo o membro posterior-compatível E_F(mu).
defect_evidence: The literal wording can identify the same numerical member across posteriors even when the posterior-dependent payoff coordinates differ.
findings.reasoning: The incidence family can remain fixed while the compatible member changes with the posterior. AMX-008 also needs its arbitrary selector explicitly confined to a fixed pure branch.
findings.disposition: Use a fixed family F and write E_F(mu); keep arbitrary selectors inside fixed branch B.

defect_evidence: The prior lemma asserted feasibility without displaying the uniform bound that makes the price sum strictly below one.
findings.reasoning: A short bound through the already defined uniform weak payoff cap gives K<1 and should be shown where the lemma is used.
findings.disposition: Add the explicit C-bar/A-g calculation without adding an economic assumption.

findings.quoted_finding: O cálculo pontual ingênuo dá 17/25, mas a parcela máxima realmente atingível é 13/25, com transferências mínimas totais 12/25.
defect_evidence: The proposal-dependent ranking changes when the pointwise cheapest voters are paid, so the old 17/25 attainability sentence fails the supplied N=5 counterexample.
findings.reasoning: The two highest offers receive degree 3 and cost 6/25 each. Every passing proposal costs at least 12/25, while 6/25 to each of the two highest offers attains 13/25.
findings.disposition: Add an exact rational R test that rejects the naive 17/25 proposal and certifies the 13/25 candidate.
